d: Spiky, short ash-brown hair is styled upwards with long bangs framing a mature, young-adult face featuring narrow, sharp amber eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black formal suit with a red dress shirt, a red necktie, and a long black coat featuring red accents, grey plated armor panels on the lower front, and a white armband on the left sleeve. Signature details include brown gloves and a silver revolver held in the left hand.
